title: Wall Mount Shower Squeegee 15-Inch Solid Brass With Hook, Traditional Style | Allied Brass
description:
Keep shower doors, tile, and mirrors clearer with quick, easy strokes using this wall mount shower squeegee crafted from solid brass.

Highlights:
- Wall mount hook keeps the squeegee securely supported when properly installed
- Helps reduce water spotting on glass shower doors, tile, and mirrors (bathroom use)
- Blade can be easily replaced
- Designer finish is built for corrosion-free and rust-free performance
- Traditional style to suit traditional bathroom hardware, classic bath accessories, and heritage bathroom fixtures

Specs:
- Overall size: 10-Inch L x 10-Inch W x 15-Inch H
- Projection: 3-Inch
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Product weight: 3.2 lb
- Included items: Squeegee, blade, mounting hook, and all installation hardware
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

_previous.title: Shower Squeegee with Smooth Handle
_previous.description: Use this shower squeegee to remove moisture in quick and easy strokes. Keep your tile, mirrors and shower doors spot-free by removing excess water after your shower. The decorative mounting hook will keep your squeegee securely supported when properly installed in the wall. Squeegee is made of the finest solid brass materials and provided with one of our designer lifetime finishes.
